The U.S. Census Bureau’s economic indicator surveys provide monthly and quarterly data that are timely, reliable, and offer comprehensive measures of the U.S. economy. These surveys provide a variety of statistics covering construction, housing, international trade, retail trade, wholesale trade, services and manufacturing.
